tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background. Slate: near-black with a blue cast. Daylight: cool paper. Everything sits on ground or pot.

tokens.name: pot
tokens.usage: Raised surface: vessels, the mouth, cards, dialogs. One step up from ground, edged by a 1px `line` hairline. No shadow at rest.

tokens.name: tan
tokens.usage: Second raise: fact tiles, compare columns, fields inside a pot. All three inks read on it, ink-3 included (4.6:1 and 4.7:1).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline borders, dividers, field edges. The only structure there is — depth is a shade and an edge, never a shadow.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text. On ground, pot and tan.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: descriptions, labels, the understood line. On ground, pot and tan.

tokens.name: ink-3
tokens.usage: Muted text: keys, timestamps, the verify strip. Clears 4.5:1 on ground, pot *and* tan in both themes.

tokens.name: green
tokens.usage: The accent, used for what is settled and what is primary: the one filled button on a screen, the confidence dot at high, done steps, active states. Text on it is `on-green`. One green thing per screen.

tokens.name: green-ink
tokens.usage: Green as text: links, ok labels, *read* in the verify strip. On ground, pot and tan.

tokens.name: on-green
tokens.usage: Text on a green fill. 6.8:1 on Slate, 5.8:1 on Daylight.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Amber, the rarest colour on the page: the notice badge, the confidence dot at mid, the one highlighted word. Fill only; never text on Daylight.

tokens.name: gold-ink
tokens.usage: Amber as text: warnings, *Shaping…*. On ground, pot and tan.

tokens.name: on-gold
tokens.usage: Text on an amber fill.

tokens.name: broth
tokens.usage: Money and consequence: price badges. A warmer orange than `gold`, so the two never read as the same signal.

tokens.name: broth-ink
tokens.usage: Prices as text, and *wrote* in the verify strip. A write is never silent.

tokens.name: steam
tokens.usage: The quietest mark: dividers inside a vessel, the trail's spine, disabled glyphs. Never text.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors, in the form that lets you reshape the question.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring. The accent in both themes now — a 2px ring in a colour that appears nowhere else on a focused control.

tokens.name: wood
tokens.usage: The band: the hero plank and any one panel that steps out of the page. A surface between ground and pot, never text. (Named for the old walnut it replaced.)

tokens.name: wood-2
tokens.usage: The band's edge. Equal to `line`, so a band is a shade change and nothing more.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Marketing headline. Inter Tight 600, cut tight — an instrument's type, not a mascot's.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: The vessel title — the question as understood, answered.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Clear, peppery broth with green banana and pumpkin.
styles.usage: Default text in vessels and prose.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Record names, chip labels when active.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Row subtext, labels, chips, the understood line.

styles.name: key
styles.usage: Uppercase keys above facts and compare facets, in ink-3. Wider tracking than before; it is a label, not a word.

styles.name: mono-small
styles.sample: placeOrder answered · read vendor, dish · wrote order
styles.usage: The verify strip and the meta line. In ink-3; `wrote` in broth-ink.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a key and its value; dot-to-text.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Chip gap, badge padding, gap inside a row.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Row padding, field padding, gap between stacked blocks in the pot.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Vessel padding, page gutter on phones.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between the mouth, the vessel and the next chips; card padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Section spacing on marketing pages.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Between marketing sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Hero padding.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, fact tiles, fields.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Vessels, buttons, the mouth.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Marketing cards and hero panels.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Chips and the confidence dot.

border.note: Hairlines, not outlines. Depth comes from one shade of surface plus a low shadow.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Every border: vessels, fields, dividers, chips — in `line`.

tokens.name: accent-bar
tokens.usage: The one thick line: under the active nav item and on the left of a selected row, in `green`.

shadow.note: Two soft shadows, warm and low — the surface lifts like a board off a table, never floats.

tokens.name: shadow-low
tokens.usage: Nothing. Depth is a shade and a hairline; a surface at rest does not float. Kept as a token so the vocabulary stays whole.

tokens.name: shadow-mid
tokens.usage: The one lift: hover, and the moment a vessel pours. A hairline of the accent plus a long, soft drop.

timing.note: Read by consumers, not rendered by the page.

tokens.name: pour
tokens.usage: The pour: opacity 0→1 with an 8px rise and a 1.5% scale-in, one eased curve. Off under prefers-reduced-motion.

tokens.name: quick
tokens.usage: Hover and focus on chips and buttons.
